reasoning_evidence: Developer's own website states 'Q4 2027' expected completion date, consistent with the queue's reported 2027-12-29 COD (sources/2026-07-19_parliamentenergy_banita-creek.html); both reflect the same internal schedule estimate rather than independent verification
Developer states '~18-month construction period'; site is in early clearing/grading as of July 2026; 18 months from mid-2026 implies Q4 2027 or Q1 2028 — COD math is internally consistent but tight

FIS study anomaly: queue data shows 'FIS Completed' from 2025-12 through 2026-04, then reverted to 'FIS Started' in 2026-05 and 2026-06 — possible design change restudy; this could trigger IA amendment and schedule revision (timeline.md)
COD has drifted 4 times (+9 months total) since first reported in 2024-07: 2027-04 → 2027-06 → 2027-08 → 2027-06 → 2027-12 (timeline.md) — history shows willingness to slide the date

Positive signals: financial security posted with Oncor (ERCOT parquet financialSecurityAndNoticeToProceedProvided=Yes), active ground construction July 2026, credible developer with completed 640 MWdc Parliament Solar project, EnCap+Mercuria backing, $500M+ private investment stated by developer — low cancellation risk despite medium schedule risk
